name: Fell Runner Carys

intro.text: Up the Blorenge and back before the kettle's boiled. I've run it in hail. Hail's actually good for the knees. Want to see my kit?

win: Photo finish. And I lost it.
after: The Blorenge, the Sugar Loaf and Pen y Fan, a skyline circuit. I'd love to do it in sunshine. I'd love to see it in sunshine.
